description: Source file implementing error handling functions for network errors, including error string conversions, error categorization, and mapping file errors to network errors.

methods.name: ErrorToString
methods.description: Converts an error code to its string representation with namespace prefix.

methods.name: ExtendedErrorToString
methods.description: Returns a string for extended errors, especially for QUIC protocol errors.

methods.name: ErrorToShortString
methods.description: Returns a short string for a given error code.

methods.name: IsCertificateError
methods.description: Checks if an error code is a certificate error.

methods.name: IsClientCertificateError
methods.description: Checks if an error code is related to client certificate issues.

methods.name: IsHostnameResolutionError
methods.description: Checks if an error code indicates hostname resolution failure.

methods.name: IsRequestBlockedError
methods.description: Checks if an error code indicates a blocked request.

methods.name: FileErrorToNetError
methods.description: Maps file error codes to network error codes.
